Subject: Your order has been placed!
Body:
Hello {{CustomerName}},

Your order {{OrderId}} is being processed. 

Thank you for shopping with us!

Subject: Your order has expired!
Body:
Hello {{CustomerName}},

You have failed to complete the payment in time for order {{OrderId}}, and the window for that has expired.

Subject: Your order has been cancelled!
Body:
Hello {{CustomerName}},

Your order {{OrderId}} has been successfully cancelled!

Subject: The shipment for your order has been created!
Body:
Hello {{CustomerName}},

Your order {{OrderId}} has been prepared and the shipment has been created. You will receive tracking details soon.

Thank you for shopping with us!

Subject: Your order has been delivered!
Body:
Hello {{CustomerName}},

Good news! Your order {{OrderId}} has been delivered. We hope you enjoy your purchase.

Thank you for shopping with us!

Subject: An item from your wishlist is discounted!
An item from your wishlist is back in stock!
Body:
Hello {{CustomerName}},

The product "{{ProductName}}" from your wishlist is now back in stock!
Current Price: {{ProductPrice}}

Hurry and grab it before it's gone!
